description: Client-side execution engine for slash commands in a chat application, handling command parsing, execution, and interaction with gateway RPC methods.

methods.name: normalizeVerboseLevel
methods.description: Normalizes raw verbose level string to predefined levels ('off', 'on', 'full').

methods.name: executeSlashCommand
methods.description: Main function to execute a slash command based on command name and arguments.

methods.name: executeHelp
methods.description: Generates help text listing available slash commands.

methods.name: executeCompact
methods.description: Requests session compaction via gateway RPC.

methods.name: executeModel
methods.description: Gets or sets the chat model for the session.

methods.name: executeThink
methods.description: Gets or sets the thinking level for the session.

methods.name: executeVerbose
methods.description: Gets or sets the verbose mode for the session.

methods.name: executeFast
methods.description: Gets or sets the fast mode for the session.

methods.name: executeUsage
methods.description: Retrieves token usage statistics for the current session.

methods.name: executeAgents
methods.description: Lists configured agents.

methods.name: executeKill
methods.description: Aborts specified sub-agent sessions.

methods.name: resolveKillTargets
methods.description: Resolves session keys matching a target name for kill operation.

methods.name: isWithinCurrentSessionSubtree
methods.description: Checks if a session key belongs to the current session's subtree.

methods.name: buildSessionIndex
methods.description: Builds an index of sessions by normalized key.

methods.name: normalizeSessionKey
methods.description: Normalizes session key string.

methods.name: resolveEquivalentSessionKeys
methods.description: Resolves equivalent session keys for default agent sessions.

methods.name: formatDirectiveOptions
methods.description: Formats a string with options for directives.

methods.name: loadCurrentSession
methods.description: Loads the current session object based on session key.

methods.name: resolveCurrentSession
methods.description: Finds the session object matching a session key or its aliases.

methods.name: loadThinkingCommandState
methods.description: Loads session and model state for thinking commands.

methods.name: loadModelCatalog
methods.description: Fetches the list of available models.

methods.name: resolveCurrentThinkingLevel
methods.description: Determines the current thinking level for a session.

methods.name: resolveCurrentFastMode
methods.description: Determines if fast mode is enabled for a session.

methods.name: resolveSteerSubagent
methods.description: Matches a target name against active subagent sessions.

methods.name: resolveSteerTarget
methods.description: Resolves a steer target from command arguments.

methods.name: isActiveSteerSession
methods.description: Checks if a session is active and running.

methods.name: executeSteer
methods.description: Queues a message into an active run without starting a new one.

methods.name: executeRedirect
methods.description: Aborts current session and restarts with a new message.

methods.name: fmtTokens
methods.description: Formats token count into a human-readable string.
